issue.title: 1.2: Upgrade vitest and @vitest/ui to a patched release

error_messages: GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp (vitest: arbitrary file read/exec via Vitest UI server)

affected_files.role: pins the vulnerable vitest stack incl. vite-node
test config; major jump 1.x -> 3.x/4.x may need API adjustments
global test setup; globals/environment options can shift between majors

analysis.summary: Installed vitest is ^1.0.4 with @vitest/ui ^1.0.4; live audit reports vitest and @vitest/ui critical (GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp) plus vite-node moderate, and the only clean fix is a semver-major jump — audit recommends 4.1.11; the smallest clearing release is 3.2.5. @vitest/coverage-v8 must move in lockstep with vitest. Vite is pinned at ^5.0.8, so the 3.2.x line is the low-coupling choice if the suite stays green; otherwise 4.x with the remaining Vite coupling documented as a spike (full Vite 5->8 is #26).
analysis.details: This issue declares `Depends on #15` — the non-force audit fix rewrites package-lock.json first, so the vitest major bump lands on a clean transitive base and the two changes never interleave in one lockfile diff. After the upgrade, acceptance requires: `npm audit` no longer reports GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp on vitest/@vitest/ui, the migration guide (or spike note) is linked in the PR, and `npm run test:run` passes at or above the recorded rate. Note the jsdom 27 / @vitest/coverage-v8 pairing also needs to match the chosen vitest major.

options.name: Minimal bump to vitest 3.2.x
options.summary: Take vitest/@vitest/ui/@vitest/coverage-v8 at the smallest patched line (>=3.2.5) and keep Vite 5 if the suite stays green.
cons: 1.x -> 3.x still skips two majors of test-API drift; 3.2.x line ages out
options.risk_details: Major jump with config and coverage-API drift; mitigated by full suite run

options.name: Go straight to 4.1.11
options.summary: Take the audit-recommended 4.1.11 line now, documenting remaining Vite 5 coupling as a spike resolved by #26.
pros: Matches audit recommendation; no second vitest jump later
cons: Larger jump against Vite 5; higher chance of config/coverage rework in this PR
options.risk_details: Two-major jump plus known Vite coupling until #26 lands

decision_record.root_cause: vitest/@vitest/ui are pinned at ^1.0.4, which carries critical advisory GHSA-5xrq-8626-4rwp; no non-breaking release clears it, so the fix is a semver-major jump of the vitest stack (vitest, @vitest/ui, @vitest/coverage-v8, vite-node) to >=3.2.5, sequenced after #15's lockfile refresh.

options_rejected.reason: Larger jump against the still-pinned Vite 5 raises rework risk in this PR; 4.x remains the fallback if 3.2.x is incompatible.

selected_option.name: Minimal bump to vitest 3.2.x
selected_option.summary: Move the vitest stack to the smallest patched line (>=3.2.5) keeping Vite 5, fall back to 4.x only if incompatible.

decision_record.residual_risk: 1.x -> 3.x API drift may still require config changes; if 3.2.x proves incompatible with Vite 5, take 4.x and record the remaining Vite coupling as a spike until #26.
